snippet.title: MIS AMIGOS - RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Mis Amigos is a short tower-defense game inspired by creepypastas, old indie flash games, and being a little kid. Use your tools and survive long enough to see your parents come back home.

PLAY IT NOW: https://bloomtoy.itch.io/mis-amigos
